tracks.title: Pursuit
tracks.reason: The main bassline is the perfect model for a simple, aggressive, heavily-distorted mono-synth pattern that drives an entire track.

tracks.title: Skeng
tracks.reason: Its rhythmic structure demonstrates maximum weight from minimal elements, and the kick/sub separation is a key target for our low end.

tracks.title: A New Error
tracks.reason: The arpeggiated melodic cell and masterful layering provide a blueprint for building tension and release over a long-form arrangement.
